name: not-json
about: Text that is not JSON gives no profiles; the problem says where, never what.

name: root-array
about: A root that is no object gives no profiles.

name: profiles-array
about: profiles that is no object gives no profiles.

name: profiles-null
about: profiles that is null gives no profiles.

name: root-key-twice
about: A second profiles block: JSON.parse would keep only the last, so the file gives none.

name: empty-file
about: A file without profiles is valid and names no engine.

name: schema-key
about: $schema names the schema for editors; defaultProfile names a profile of the file.

name: schema-not-string
about: $schema that is no string is a note; the file loads.

name: root-unknown-key
about: An unknown root key is a note; the profiles load.

name: default-not-string
about: defaultProfile that is no string is a note, and there is no default.

name: default-invalid-name
about: defaultProfile that is no profile name is a note, and there is no default.

name: default-foreign
about: defaultProfile that names no profile of the file is a note (JSON Schema cannot say so); it never falls back to the only profile.

name: default-blank
about: A blank defaultProfile means none.

name: default-padded
about: defaultProfile is trimmed before it is looked up.

name: profile-not-object
about: A profile that is no object is refused; the others load.

name: profile-invalid-name
about: A name with a space is refused by its position: it is never shown.

name: profile-name-twice
about: A name the text lists twice is refused: JSON.parse would keep only the last profile.

name: profile-names-of-digits
about: Names of digits are names; the profiles keep the order of the text, which JSON.parse would change.

name: profile-key-twice
about: A key twice in a profile refuses it: a second readOnly would switch the guard off silently.

name: auth-key-twice
about: A key twice in auth refuses the profile.

name: header-twice
about: A header name twice refuses the profile.

name: header-twice-in-two-spellings
about: A header name twice in two spellings refuses the profile: HTTP ignores the case of a name, and fetch would send both values joined.

name: key-twice-first-no-object
about: A name or a key twice whose first value is no object (a string, a list) refuses its profile, read at the last value as JSON.parse keeps it.

name: profile-unknown-key
about: An unknown key refuses its profile: a typo never works silently.

name: profile-former-key
about: platform, the former name of flavor, is an unknown key.

name: profile-unknown-key-not-shown
about: An unknown key that does not look like one may be a credential: it is refused but never shown.

name: url-blank
about: A blank url is refused.

name: url-not-string
about: A url that is no string is refused.

name: url-refused
about: A url that is no http or https URL, or carries credentials, a query or a fragment, is refused without being shown.

name: url-normalized
about: url loses surrounding blanks and trailing slashes, cockpitUrl also the start route of its app.

name: cockpit-refused
about: A cockpitUrl that is no http or https URL, or carries credentials or a query, is refused.

name: cockpit-not-string
about: A cockpitUrl that is no string is refused.

name: url-optional
about: A profile without url is valid; a reader that needs one refuses it (refusalsOn).

name: engine-dots
about: An engine name that would leave /engine/{name} is refused.

name: engine-not-string
about: An engine that is no string is refused.

name: engines
about: The default engine by name, padded, and a named one; whether a reader reaches it is refusalsOn's.

name: flavor-not-string
about: A flavor that is no string is refused.

name: flavor-padded
about: Flavors are compared exactly, blanks included.

name: flavor-unknown
about: A flavor of no known dialect is refused, without being shown.

name: flavors
about: Each flavor, and none; readOnly false is a writable engine.

name: environment
about: An environment groups engines on an MCP server; digits alone are an id too.

name: environment-invalid
about: An environment that is no id is refused.

name: output-unknown
about: An output format the CLI does not know is refused.

name: timeout-invalid
about: A timeout is a whole number of milliseconds a timer can hold.

name: read-only-not-boolean
about: A readOnly that is no boolean is refused: never a writable engine by mistake.

name: every-profile-key
about: Every profile key, none of them a credential.

name: header-boundaries
about: Header names are HTTP tokens; values are Latin-1 with tabs.

name: header-invalid
about: A header name that is no token, one the client manages and a value with a line break are refused.

name: header-secret
about: A secret header: only a person's own file keeps one.

name: auth-not-object
about: An auth that is no object is refused.

name: auth-type-not-string
about: An auth.type that is no string is refused.

name: auth-unknown-key
about: An unknown auth key refuses its profile.

name: auth-token-command
about: The token command of 0.6.0 is an unknown key: only the CLI's environment gives one.

name: auth-type-unknown
about: An auth type no reader knows is refused, without being shown.

name: auth-implied
about: Without a type a username selects Basic auth, else none; type none switches stored settings off.

name: auth-supported
about: Every auth type and its keys without a credential; the secret comes from elsewhere.

name: auth-mixed
about: Basic auth and OAuth keys in one profile are refused.

name: auth-mixed-token
about: Basic auth and bearer token keys in one profile are refused.

name: auth-oauth-keys-basic-type
about: OAuth keys with type basic are refused.

name: auth-oauth-without-type
about: OAuth is never implied: OAuth keys need type oauth.

name: auth-username-oauth-type
about: A username with type oauth is refused.

name: auth-passthrough-keys
about: passthrough forwards the caller's token and takes no other key.

name: auth-token-without-type
about: A stored token is never implied: its keys need type bearer.

name: auth-one-endpoint
about: With type oauth, one endpoint without the other is refused.

name: auth-one-endpoint-off
about: With type none, the OAuth keys are off, a single endpoint included.

name: auth-username-invalid
about: A username is not blank and holds neither ":" nor a control character.

name: auth-oauth-values-invalid
about: OAuth values of the wrong shape are refused.

name: auth-password
about: A password itself: only a person's own file keeps one.

name: auth-password-variable
about: A variable outside ENGINE_SECRET_: a shared file names none, an MCP server reads none.

name: auth-password-secret-variable
about: A variable under ENGINE_SECRET_: what an MCP server reads; a shared file still names none.

name: auth-variable-not-a-name
about: A variable that is no name is refused, never shown.

name: auth-token-variable
about: The variable of a bearer token.

name: auth-token
about: A bearer token itself.

name: auth-client-secret-variable
about: The variable of an OAuth client secret.

name: auth-client-secret
about: An OAuth client secret itself.

name: auth-secret-twice
about: A secret and its variable together: keep one.

name: future-dialect
about: A flavor and an auth type of a later dialect refuse only their profile; the C7 profile next to it loads.

name: operator-file
about: The profiles of an MCP server: variables under ENGINE_SECRET_, passthrough, an OAuth profile and a default.

name: project-file
about: A file a team shares: engines without any credential, read the same under every policy.
